status: proposed production contract, not deployed in this reference

preview.scope: route/day/start/speed in fixed demo week; not persistent snapshot shortener

resolve.result: same route/date/start/speed and saved forecast revision
resolve.expired: clear expired state with explicit refresh choice; do not silently substitute a different plan

production.opaque_id: server-generated and collision checked; never derive persistent id from a local index

url_placement: share preview below image + caption; no URL in PNG
fallback: save image stays available; no extra link-copy or URL-type choices
